notes: Umbra: a single-file, strictly monochrome, scroll-driven total solar eclipse. One canvas draws the Sun, Moon, corona, diamond ring and stars; page scroll moves the Moon through five contacts, using the exact circle-overlap area for obscuration. Below it are a short manifesto, a table of upcoming total eclipses with live day counts, and eye-safety guidance. Honest limits: it was not opened in a real browser by the author (none was available), only syntax-checked and smoke-tested in Node with a stubbed DOM and canvas; visual tuning of the corona and layout is therefore unverified. Type uses system font stacks (Didone-style display where installed, otherwise Georgia), so appearance varies by platform. Eclipse dates, paths and durations were written from memory and are approximate.
